title: Bootstrapped dev experience: micro-illustrations for auth, keys, streaming, and tool calls
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Create a compact set of micro-illustrations and screenshot compositions for the API/SDK quickstart that cover: 1) API key creation & scoped key best practices, 2) SDK auth config snippet (node/python), 3) streaming request lifecycle (client -> server -> streaming tokens -> append UI), and 4) tool-calling flow with example tool registration and error fallback. These assets will appear in the public docs quickstart, README hero, and Console setup flow. The deliverables should be optimized for small inline usage (48–320px width), exported as optimized SVG + PNG fallbacks, and provided as Figma components with tokenized colors for dark/light variants.
acceptance_criteria: All four visual types exported as optimized SVGs with accessibility-friendly color contrast
Figma components published to team library and versioned (v1.0)
Documentation-ready screenshot compositions (desktop + mobile) added to docs PR with alt text and copy notes
Code snippets used in images match SDK v2.3 examples and include minimal error handling
Design handoff includes tokens, spacing guidelines, and two size variants (compact, hero)
tasks: Design initial sketches for each flow (auth, sdk-snippet, streaming, toolcall)
Iterate based on PM review and sync with eng for snippet accuracy
Create Figma components and publish to library
Export SVG/PNG assets and place in shared Drive folder
Prepare docs PR with example usages and alt text
